title: record page: skills rule and QA checklist items still describe the right summary rail and its shortcut retired by #35890
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Companion to #35890 (PR #36136). Raised as S2 by the seat's declaration review on PR #36136 (record 7069204397). PR #36136 retires the record page's right summary rail, its ⊟ switch and the `⌘⇧,` shortcut, and deletes `RecordSummaryRail.tsx`. Text outside that PR still describes them.

## The gap

- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md` still teaches the ⊟ right-column switch and `⌘⇧,`.
- Six platform checklist items still point at the right rail or the deleted file: five in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/` `records-forms.json` and one in `attachments-storage.json`. A run of them would fail a working product.

## What to do

1. Reword the skills rule to today's layout (fields pinned in the left column when 320 + 400 fit, ruling 7064066204 on #35890; no right rail). Skills edits ride a `domain:skills` PR.
2. Update or retire the six checklist items so they test the pinned left column instead.
3. Start after PR #36136 merges.

Blocked-by: #36136
